ctaHeading: Get your auto electrics fixed in Sunshine West today.
aboutText: AB Auto Electrics was established in 1994 in Footscray and has grown to serve Sunshine West and Melbourne's western suburbs. With a large team of qualified automotive electricians, we cater to all auto electrical needs, from diagnostics to installations. Our honest and professional approach has built a reputation for reliable service across the community.
servicesText: From battery replacements to complex wiring repairs, we provide comprehensive auto electrical services. Our qualified team uses the latest technology to diagnose and fix issues efficiently. We serve both domestic and commercial clients across Melbourne's west.

services.title: Battery Services
services.desc: Testing, replacement and maintenance for all vehicle batteries to keep you on the road reliably.

services.title: Alternator Repairs
services.desc: Expert repair and replacement of alternators to ensure your vehicle's electrical system charges properly.

services.title: Starter Motor Services
services.desc: Diagnosis and repair of starter motor issues for reliable and quick engine starting every time.

services.title: Wiring and Diagnostics
services.desc: Comprehensive electrical diagnostics and wiring repairs using advanced diagnostic tools for accuracy.

services.title: Lighting Installation
services.desc: Installation and repair of headlights, tail lights and interior lighting for safety and visibility on the road.

services.title: Accessory Fitting
services.desc: Professional installation of aftermarket accessories like audio systems, alarms and custom electrical upgrades.
